profile.name: Innova 300C 系列离子激光器
profile.description: Innova 300C 系列是一类实验室用连续波气体离子激光器，常见版本包括氩离子和氪离子型号，用于提供稳定的可见光激光输出。该设备常用于光学实验、光谱测试、荧光激发、光路对准以及其他需要连续激光源的科研场景，并支持通过电流、功率及腔内相关参数进行输出优化。
profile.description_en: The Innova 300C Series is a laboratory continuous-wave gas ion laser family, with common versions including argon-ion and krypton-ion models, used to provide stable visible laser output. It is commonly used in optical experiments, spectroscopy, fluorescence excitation, beam alignment, and other research applications requiring a continuous laser source, with output optimization through current, power, and intracavity-related settings.
